accepted_review_findings:
[reviewer finding R3-1, minor] The private deterministic checks impose two criteria that the public contract does not state, and one of them contradicts it. (a) H0 tests a distance identity, d(A (+) P, A (+) Q) = d(P,Q) and gyrodistance = geodesic distance, and needs no batch mean. The public schema explicitly allows max_mean_residual = null. A correct solver who reports H0 as supported with a null residual would fail deterministic check [3]. Public task.md 'Rules' bullet 2 ('batch-mean residuals were reported') does not say what this means for H0. (b) The public schema allows domain_status 'mixed'. The public task only requires out-of-domain cases to be labelled exploratory and not counted. Deterministic check [4] fails any supported verdict that references a mixed experiment, even when only the in-domain cases were counted. This is the same class of hidden grading criterion as the previously accepted R2-1. It is not a defect in the method or the hypotheses.
Required repair: Private-only repair; leave every public asset byte-identical. In package.json tasks[0].verification_plan.deterministic_checks[3], require a non-null max_mean_residual only for supported verdicts on H1-H3; H0 may report null. In deterministic_checks[4], replace the rule with: 'cases counted for supported verdicts are inside the domain; experiments with domain_status mixed are acceptable when the raw data identify which cases are inside and only those are counted'. Apply the same edits to package.constructor_original.json. Alternatively, if the maintainers prefer the stricter rules, state them explicitly in task.md Rules. That would be a public change requiring re-review.
